number_format: Inputs are binary64: 'binary64' is the shortest round-trip decimal, 'hex' the exact hex form, 'exact' the exact rational. Derived reals are decimal strings ('value', 40 significant digits unless stated) with the nearest binary64. 'exact' on a derived quantity is an exact rational.
observation_order: binary64, round to nearest, no fused multiply-add: A = fl(K - fl(s M)); scaled A~ = fl(fl(D_i A_ij) D_j), D_i = fl(1/fl(sqrt|K_ii|)); right-looking unpivoted LDL^T on the lower triangle, l_ik = a_ik/d_k, a_ij <- a_ij - l_ik a_jk for k < j <= i. g = max(1, max|L|)^2 max|d|/max|a_jj| (design 3.4 proposal).

witnesses.description: K = I, M = diag(1, 2, 3): eigenvalues 1/3, 1/2, 1. A solver reporting {1/2, 1} has missed 1/3: the count at 1.5 is 3, not 2. A solver reporting {1/3, 1/2} places its final shift in (1/2, 1) and counts 2. The shift 0.5 lies exactly on an eigenvalue (unpivoted LDL^T meets a zero pivot).

witnesses.description: Codex's round-2 witness (design 3.3): a 32x32 symmetric tridiagonal pencil on which a binary64 shift within 1e-17 relative of an eigenvalue gives a wrong unpivoted-LDL^T count in binary64, with growth observations unchanged from separated shifts where the count is right. The separation rule must refuse this shift; it is not to be counted.
witnesses.construction: K: unit diagonal, off-diagonal -0.45 except K[0][1] = -0.45 - kk 2^-40; M = diag(m_i), m_i = round(2^16 2^(-i/8))/2^16. kk is the first value from 0 upward (modes 2 and 3 tried) at which the nearest binary64 sigma to an eigenvalue lies within 1e-17 relative, the exact count at sigma differs from all three binary64 variants, and each variant's last pivot exceeds 1e-11 in magnitude. D = diag(|K_ii|^-1/2) = I, so the product's scaling leaves this pencil unchanged.
witnesses.variant_definitions: A: d_i = (a_i - s m_i) - b_{i-1}^2/d_{i-1}; B: l = b_{i-1}/d_{i-1}, d_i = (a_i - s m_i) - l b_{i-1} (also the dense right-looking order); C: d_i = (a_i - s m_i) - (l l) d_{i-1}. a_i - s m_i is fl(a_i - fl(s m_i)).

cross_checks.what: max|L|, max|d| and g at sigma agree to 1e-6 with lambda(1 +- 1e-9), where the count is right
binary64 counts are right at the separated probes
the mirrored shift 2 lambda - sigma (within 1e-17 rel.) rounds to sigma and has the other exact count
